metadata.title: Seedance Versions: 1.0, 1.5 Pro, 2.0 and 2.5 Explained
metadata.description: Compare Seedance 1.0, Seedance 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0, Fast, Mini, and Seedance 2.5 by release context, capabilities, access, and workflow fit.

hero.title: Seedance Versions
hero.description: A version guide for Seedance 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 searches. Track the exact model and provider because names, limits, pricing, and availability change over time.
hero.tip: Version labels are not interchangeable. Record the full model name or ID shown by the provider for every prompt, output, and price comparison.

introduce.title: Why Seedance version matters
introduce.description: A query for “Seedance” can refer to a release, a speed tier, a hosted provider model, or a community wrapper. Version and surface are the first facts to verify.

items.title: Seedance 1.0
items.description: An earlier generation in the model family, relevant to historical and comparison searches rather than current site generation.

items.title: Seedance 1.5 Pro
items.description: An important earlier Pro release with its own input, audio, and output behavior on supported providers.

items.title: Seedance 2.0
items.description: The current browser generator version on this site, with supported text, image, video, and audio-visual workflows.

items.title: Seedance 2.5
items.description: The newer model line focused on longer storytelling, richer references, and more precise editing through supported access surfaces.

benefits.title: How to compare Seedance versions
benefits.description: Use the project requirement as the comparison key: speed, fidelity, duration, references, editing, audio, resolution, cost, or availability.

items.title: Speed tiers
items.description: Fast and Mini may trade output ceiling, cost, or resolution for iteration speed. Check the provider’s exact behavior.

items.title: Multimodal inputs
items.description: Compare text, image, video, audio, first/last frames, and combined reference support by version and mode.

items.title: Long-form output
items.description: Seedance 2.5 is positioned for 30-second storytelling and extensions; older versions may expose shorter limits.

items.title: Access and terms
items.description: A newer model can be available on one platform while an older model is easier to access elsewhere. Compare rights and price too.

features.title: Version record for reproducible work
features.description: Keep these details with the output so an upgrade does not silently change your workflow.

items.title: Model name and ID
items.description: Copy the exact provider label, including version date or tier when shown.

items.title: Provider and region

items.title: Input materials

items.title: Output settings

items.title: Prompt and result
items.description: Keep the prompt, task ID, output URL, and quality notes together.

items.title: Terms at the time
items.description: Capture plan, commercial rights, moderation, retention, and price source date.

faq.title: Seedance Versions FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: What is the newest Seedance version?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 is the newer model covered by this plan, while Seedance 2.0 remains the current browser generator version on this site. Verify the provider’s current catalog.

items.question: When was Seedance 2.0 released?
items.answer: ByteDance Seed announced the official Seedance 2.0 launch in February 2026. Provider rollouts and model IDs may use a later version date.

items.question: When was Seedance 2.5 released?
items.answer: ByteDance Seed introduced Seedance 2.5 on July 31, 2026. Access and API availability should be checked on the current official source.

items.question: Is Seedance 1.5 Pro still available?
items.answer: Some providers may retain older versions, but availability and pricing are provider-specific. Check the current model selector before planning around it.

items.question: Which version is best for fighting scenes?
items.answer: Test the exact motion, interaction, reference, and safety requirements. Version reputation alone cannot guarantee a stable result for a particular scene.

items.question: Are Seedance Fast and Mini separate versions?
items.answer: They are commonly presented as tiers or model variants with different limits. Use the provider’s exact model name and documentation to compare them.

cta.title: Choose by workflow, then record the version
cta.description: Use the model that is available and suitable for the task, and keep the full version and provider details with every result.
